description: This file defines logging categories and a log host utility class for the MigraDoc library, including static properties to access different loggers for various parts of the library.

classes.name: MigraDocLogCategory
classes.description: Contains constant strings representing different logging categories for MigraDoc.

classes.name: MigraDocLogHost
classes.description: Provides static access to various loggers for MigraDoc components, managing logger instances and handling factory changes.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.MigraDocLogger
methods.description: Property that returns the global logger for general MigraDoc logs.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.DocumentModelLogger
methods.description: Property for the logger related to the MigraDoc Document Object Model.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.PdfRenderingLogger
methods.description: Property for the logger related to PDF rendering activities.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.RtfRenderingLogger
methods.description: Property for the RTF rendering logger.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.CheckFactoryHasChanged
methods.description: Method to check if the logger factory has changed and reset loggers if necessary.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.ResetLogging
methods.description: Method to reset all logger instances when the factory changes.
